```{r}
# -------------------------
# d -> eta2 -> f2 and participant counts (design-effect method)
# -------------------------
# install packages if needed
if (!requireNamespace("pwr", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("pwr")
if (!requireNamespace("sjstats", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("sjstats")

library(pwr)      # pwr.f2.test
library(sjstats)  # design_effect
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(purrr)
```

```{r}
d = 0.24                # your Cohen's d
alpha_family = 0.05
k_planned =   4        # number of planned comparisons (Bonferroni)
alpha_adj = alpha_family / k_planned   # adjusted alpha
power_target = 0.80
cluster_size = 12       # 6 QRPs x 2 roles = 12 vignette rows per participant
icc_grid = c(0.20, 0.35, 0.40, 0.45, 0.50)   # ICC sensitivity grid
```


```{r}
d2 = d^2
f2_from_d = d2 / 5             # shortcut: f^2 = d^2 / 5 
eta2_from_d = d2 / (d2 + 5)    # eta^2 = d^2 / (d^2 + 5)

cat("Inputs:\n")
cat("  d =", d, "\n")
cat("  d^2 =", round(d2, 5), "\n")
cat("Conversions:\n")
cat("  f^2 (from d) =", round(f2_from_d, 6), "\n")
cat("  eta^2 (from d) =", round(eta2_from_d, 6), "\n\n")
```


```{r}
compute_required = function(f2, icc, alpha = alpha_adj, power = power_target, m = cluster_size){
  # numerator df for pairwise contrast
  u = 1
  pw = pwr.f2.test(u = u, f2 = f2, sig.level = alpha, power = power)
  v = pw$v            # denominator df (flat-design requirement)
  deff = design_effect(n = m, icc = icc)   # 1 + (m-1)*ICC
  total_long_rows = v * deff
  participants_needed = ceiling(total_long_rows / m)
  tibble::tibble(
    f2 = f2, icc = icc, denom_df_v = round(v, 1),
    design_effect = round(deff, 3),
    total_long_rows = round(total_long_rows),
    participants_needed = participants_needed
  )
}
```


```{r}
results = purrr::map_dfr(icc_grid, ~compute_required(f2_from_d, icc = .x))

# print table
results = dplyr::mutate(results, scenario = paste0("d=", d, " -> f2=", signif(f2_from_d, 4)))
select_cols = c("scenario","icc","f2","denom_df_v","design_effect","total_long_rows","participants_needed")
print(dplyr::select(results, dplyr::all_of(select_cols)))
```

```{r}
compute_required = function(f2, icc, alpha = alpha_adj, power = power_target, m = cluster_size){
  # numerator df for pairwise contrast
  u = 1
  pw = pwr.f2.test(u = u, f2 = f2, sig.level = alpha, power = power)
  v = pw$v            # denominator df (flat-design requirement)
  deff = design_effect(n = m, icc = icc)   # 1 + (m-1)*ICC
  total_long_rows = v * deff
  participants_needed = ceiling(total_long_rows / m)
  tibble::tibble(
    f2 = f2, icc = icc, denom_df_v = round(v, 1),
    design_effect = round(deff, 3),
    total_long_rows = round(total_long_rows),
    participants_needed = participants_needed
  )
}
```

```{r}
# VIGNETTE A PRIORI POWER ANALYSIS
# 3 Vignettes x 2 Researcher Roles

library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)


#settings

d = 0.24
f2 = 0.012

alpha_family = 0.05
k_planned = 4
alpha_adj = alpha_family / k_planned

power_target = 0.80

# Number of simulations
n_sim = 100

# Sample sizes to test
sample_sizes = c(250, 300, 350, 400, 450, 500, 550, 600)

# Participant-level ICCs
icc_grid = c(0.20, 0.35, 0.40, 0.45, 0.50)


# 3 vignettes x 2 researcher roles
design = expand.grid(
  vignette = 1:3,
  role = c("Investigator", "Inspector")
)

# Make researcher role categorical
design$role = factor(
  design$role,
  levels = c("Investigator", "Inspector")
)

# Make QRP severity categorical
design$severity = factor(
  c("Minor", "Moderate", "Major")[design$vignette],
  levels = c("Minor", "Moderate", "Major")
)

simulate_data = function(N, icc, d = 0.24) {

  # Six ratings per participant:
  # 3 vignettes x 2 researcher roles

  dat = design[
    rep(1:nrow(design), times = N),
  ]

  # Participant ID
  dat$participant = rep(
    1:N,
    each = nrow(design)
  )

# PARTICIPANT RANDOM EFFECT

  residual_sd = 1

  participant_sd =
    sqrt(
      (icc * residual_sd^2) /
        (1 - icc)
    )

  participant_effect =
    rnorm(
      N,
      mean = 0,
      sd = participant_sd
    )

  dat$participant_effect =
    participant_effect[dat$participant]

#fixed effects 
  
  # Main effect of researcher role
  beta_role = d

  # Main effect of severity
  beta_severity = 0

  # Role x severity interaction
  beta_interaction = d

  # Investigator = -0.5
  # Inspector = +0.5

  role_num = ifelse(
    dat$role == "Inspector",
    0.5,
    -0.5
  )

  # Minor = -1
  # Moderate = 0
  # Major = +1

  severity_num = ifelse(
    dat$severity == "Minor",
    -1,
    ifelse(
      dat$severity == "Moderate",
      0,
      1
    )
  )


  dat$y =
    4 +
    beta_role * role_num +
    beta_severity * severity_num +
    beta_interaction *
      role_num *
      severity_num +
    dat$participant_effect +
    rnorm(
      nrow(dat),
      mean = 0,
      sd = residual_sd
    )

  return(dat)
}


test_simulation = function(
    N,
    icc,
    d = 0.24
) {

  dat = simulate_data(
    N = N,
    icc = icc,
    d = d
  )


  model = tryCatch(

    suppressWarnings(
      lmer(
        y ~ role * severity +
          (1 | participant),
        data = dat,
        REML = FALSE
      )
    ),

    error = function(e) NULL
  )


  # If model fails
  if (is.null(model)) {
    return(NA)
  }


# TEST THE ROLE x SEVERITY EFFECT

  # Get the model coefficients
  model_summary =
    summary(model)$coefficients

  # Get the two interaction terms
  interaction_rows =
    grep(
      "roleInspector:severity",
      rownames(model_summary)
    )


  # If interaction terms cannot be found
  if (length(interaction_rows) == 0) {
    return(NA)
  }


  # Get p-values for the interaction terms
  interaction_p =
    model_summary[
      interaction_rows,
      "Pr(>|t|)"
    ]


  # Require BOTH interaction terms to be significant
  # after Bonferroni correction

  return(
    all(
      interaction_p < alpha_adj
    )
  )
}


# RUN POWER FOR ONE SAMPLE SIZE AND ICC

run_power = function(
    N,
    icc,
    n_sim = 100,
    d = 0.24
) {

  results = replicate(
    n_sim,

    test_simulation(
      N = N,
      icc = icc,
      d = d
    )
  )


  # Remove failed simulations
  results =
    results[
      !is.na(results)
    ]


  # Calculate power
  power =
    mean(results)


  data.frame(
    N = N,
    ICC = icc,
    simulations = length(results),
    power = power
  )
}

# RUN ALL SAMPLE SIZE x ICC COMBINATIONS
power_results =
  expand.grid(
    N = sample_sizes,
    ICC = icc_grid
  ) %>%

  purrr::pmap_dfr(
    function(N, ICC) {

      cat(
        "Running N =", N,
        "ICC =", ICC, "\n"
      )

      run_power(
        N = N,
        icc = ICC,
        n_sim = n_sim,
        d = d
      )
    }
  )


# VIEW POWER RESULTS

power_results =
  power_results %>%
  mutate(
    power = round(power, 3)
  )

print(power_results)


# FIND SMALLEST SAMPLE SIZE WITH 80% POWER

required_N =
  power_results %>%
  filter(
    power >= power_target
  ) %>%
  group_by(ICC) %>%
  summarise(
    required_N = min(N),
    power = power[N == min(N)][1],
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(required_N)
```
